name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow with role-pinned Luna / Max and Luna / Medium implementation lanes, a budgeted, fresh requested-read-only Sol review, and a rare external Claude Opus Challenger.

interface.shortDescription: Architect with Sol, implement with role-pinned Luna / Max or the Luna / Medium floor lane, review with Sol, and use the external Claude Opus Challenger on rare triggers.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex a delivery workflow: GPT-5.6 Sol orchestrates and classifies each task, a role-pinned GPT-5.6 Luna / Max agent handles judgment-bearing implementation while a GPT-5.6 Luna / Medium floor lane takes mechanical edits, and a fresh requested-read-only Sol reviewer must approve the final diff within a bounded review budget. A rare external Claude Opus Challenger provides a cross-model-family second opinion for deadlock, irreversible, or user-request triggers.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Classify this task with Sol Advisor and route it to the right implementation lane.
Review this deliverable with a fresh Sol advisor before reporting done.
